title: I built a SaaS in 48 hours using only AI — here's what happened

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What if I told you I built a working SaaS in 48 hours using only AI?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This is the future of startups — fast, cheap, and accessible to everyone.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: I created a tool that automates content creation for social media managers.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It uses AI to generate, edit, and schedule posts across multiple platforms.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects every marketer, freelancer, and small business owner — saving them hours daily.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? AI isn’t just a tool — it’s a game-changer for productivity.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Want to see how I did it? Drop a comment below and I’ll show you step by step.
